prerequisite: Uncommitted C4L cost harness and C4M1 premultiplied resolve/oracle; historical evidence retained.
scope: Exact accepted-list ordering on qualified full-target opt-in views, with bounded native image/chain controls and repeated live cost observations. Not public-show adoption or smoke-art approval.

implementation.algorithm: Overflow-only in-place bottom-up linked merge sort, then existing premultiplied resolve
implementation.work: O(N log N) per overflowing pixel list, O(1) private state. Short-list validation O(N); unchanged local fast sort below threshold.
implementation.storage: Reuses the existing 12-byte nodes and heads, native dynamic View/settings uniforms; no new fragment/index/uniform data buffer or production readback.
implementation.ownership: Aestra-approved full-target cameras only; diagnostics before sort, sort before native resolve. Bind group released when no views approved. Optional render resources/low storage-binding limits handled.
implementation.local_threshold: Existing 1..32 setting now selects the local fast path; no longer an accepted-layer quality cap.
implementation.bounds: Validate chains before rewriting, stop at allocated node capacity, clear malformed/cyclic heads. Valid merge passes scale with counted list length. This is a storage/work bound, not a hardware-independent worst-case GPU-time guarantee.
implementation.ordering: Descending native packed reverse depth/alpha, canonical color tie breaker. Physical equal-depth semantics and finer-than-24-bit depth separation not certified.
implementation.cold_behavior: Native resolver remains while specialization is pending; sorting can be pending independently. No repaired first-cold-frame guarantee.

chain_contract.readback: Test-only synthetic nodes/heads, not a runtime readback path

runs.source_note: Preliminary host source before optional-resource/capability guards; identical production sort shader. Second run uses final source.

dense.scope: 480x360 HDR floating intermediate/sRGB capture, flat semantic planes, frame 30/seed 1, opposite cameras/reversed creation, local thresholds 1/8/32, 40 smoke/40 additive/41 interleaved layers, average16/64MiB to isolate local overflow; zero global drops/invalid links

regression.scope: Depth, camera lifecycle, clipping, HDR, lighting, textured/flipbook, mixed paths, global loss; diagnostic/global/local capacity images excluded from prior 1694 count. Local-overflow saturation now positively asserts the image bound.

live.method: Unchanged C4L 24-case counterbalanced two-repetition matrix. Forward PlaybackOnly frames360..600, 240 absolute-deadline60Hz host updates, no seek/frame skips. 540p/1080p ordinary/default/provisioned OIT, same saved high show/four-cohort inputs. Cost scans off, independently initialized capacity scans on.
live.interpretation: Async samples deduplicated by source time/sequence, not frame-ID joined. Do not sum pass percentiles or infer frame-aligned isolated overhead from median differences. Full render graph excludes game/audio/presentation and much preparation; app.update is not GPU completion.
live.legacy_capacity_field: Raw observed_exact_capacity retains C4L's within-local-prefix/no-drop predicate. It remains false here; over_sort counts merge-sort work and neither predicate is an image oracle.
